instruction.text: Are these statements about colons in lists true or false?

atoms.a: In a full sentence, a colon introducing a list has to come after an independent clause.
Colons are used to separate different items in a list.
The list that comes after a colon has to be an independent clause.

instruction.text: Drag the colon to the correct place in the text.

atoms.a: A lot of people are coming to my party: Kieran, Lucinda, the Smith twins, Olivia and many others.
atoms.b: A lot of people are coming to my party((:)) Kieran, Lucinda, the Smith twins, Olivia and many others.

atoms.a: Ruby is really forgetful and loses things every week: her house keys, her makeup, her wallet and even her phone.
atoms.b: Ruby is really forgetful and loses things every week((:)) her house keys, her makeup, her wallet and even her phone.

instruction.text: Is the colon used correctly in this list?

atoms.a: My uncle has visited: lots of countries Brazil, Italy, Turkey, Mongolia, Morocco and more.

instruction.text: Punctuate the list correctly by dragging the colon to the correct place.

atoms.b: My uncle has visited lots of countries((:)) Brazil, Italy, Turkey, Mongolia, Morocco and more.

instruction.text: Is the colon used correctly in this list?

atoms.a: Mandy found some: new hobbies crochet, birdwatching, frisbee and samba dancing.

instruction.text: Punctuate the list correctly by dragging the colon to the correct place.

atoms.b: Mandy found some new hobbies((:)) crochet, birdwatching, frisbee and samba dancing.

instruction.text: Does there need to be a colon after the underlined word?

atoms.a: I want to join new clubs at school, <u>like</u> chess club, choir and book club.
Rasmus, don’t forget you have three pieces of homework due in <u>tomorrow</u> grammar exercises, maths questions and a book to read.

instruction.text: Punctuate the list correctly by dragging the colon to the correct place.

atoms.b: Rasmus, don’t forget you have three pieces of homework due in tomorrow((:)) grammar exercises, maths questions and a book to read.
